captures.name: architecture-long
captures.title: Sample Web App
captures.desc: This example shows a web application and its authored connections. Users connect to CloudFront, followed by a load balancer and an API server. The API has connections to Redis for read-through caching and to PostgreSQL for SQL access. CloudFront also connects to S3 for static assets. The asynchronous branch runs from the API to an SQS queue and then to a worker. An Auth Provider is connected to the API by a relationship labelled verify JWT. The diagram groups the cloud components within an AWS region and places the load balancer and API within a security group. It illustrates structure and labelled relationships; it does not establish measured latency, runtime availability, or the exact chronological order of authentication.
